Add Flemmas from a Caller-Supplied AntBNC Lemma List

lexdiv_flemmatize.Rd

Maps token surface forms to family lemmas (flemmas) using a local AntBNC lemma-list file on either a single tokenization (lexdiv_flemmatize()) or a named batch of tokenizations (lexdiv_flemmatize_batch()).

Usage

lexdiv_flemmatize(
  x,
  resource,
  overrides = NULL,
  normalization = "nfkc_lower",
  resource_version = NULL,
  override_version = NULL
)

lexdiv_flemmatize_batch(
  documents,
  resource,
  overrides = NULL,
  normalization = "nfkc_lower",
  resource_version = NULL,
  override_version = NULL
)

Arguments

x

An object created by lexdiv_tokenize.

documents

A named list of lexdiv_tokenization objects (such as from lexdiv_tokenize_batch).

resource

Path to a caller-supplied AntBNC lemma-list text file in headword<TAB>-><TAB>form... format.

overrides

Optional data frame with unique form and flemma columns.

normalization

"nfkc_lower" (default) or "identity".

resource_version, override_version

Optional path-free caller version labels.

Value

lexdiv_flemmatize() returns a lexdiv_tokenization object with flemma, flemma_matched, and flemma_match_rule columns. lexdiv_flemmatize_batch() returns an input-ordered named list of flemma-annotated lexdiv_tokenization objects.

See also

lexdiv_preprocessing, nj8_profile

Examples

fixture <- tempfile(fileext = ".txt")
writeLines(c("cat\t->\tcat\tcats", "see\t->\tsaw\tsee", "the\t->\tthe"),
  fixture, useBytes = TRUE)

batch <- lexdiv_tokenize_batch(c(d1 = "The cats saw.", d2 = "Cats see."))
flem_batch <- lexdiv_flemmatize_batch(
  batch, fixture, resource_version = "synthetic-help-fixture"
)
unlink(fixture)

lexdiv_metrics_text_batch(flem_batch, unit = "flemma", metrics = "ttr")$results
#> <lexdiv_batch_results: 2 documents; 2 metric records; schema 0.1.0>
#>   document_id metric_id value status missing_reason N V below_quality_floor
#> 1          d1       ttr     1     ok           <NA> 3 3               FALSE
#> 2          d2       ttr     1     ok           <NA> 2 2               FALSE
